snippet.title: Major League Hockey for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

???


Game description:

Major League Hockey is an ice-hockey game, where 2 teams (Home and Visitor) fight it out on the ice-hockey field.

You can play as either of the 2 teams and play against other players (the game supports 4 controller ports) or the computer.

You can also adjust the length of the periods and the difficulty of the computer.


What I think:

A really fun ice-hockey game, although the puck is not that easy to see.
